items.title: apps.gankdat.com/reader-mode-alternative.html: a comparison page for Reader Mode / ADHD-reading users who search for a working alternative, linked from the landing and both listings
items.why: RESEARCH.md 2026-09-18: Reader Mode (100k users, 3.1★) crashes and sold a lifetime promo without the promised features; the official bolding tool (100k, 2.4★, last update Jun 2024) 'doesn't work'; every ruler tool's top reviews ask for PDF; ADHD Reading charges $29/yr or $59 lifetime and 'developers don't respond'. Those users search 'reader mode alternative', 'reading ruler chrome', 'adhd reading extension' and nothing of ours answers it. STRATEGY §5: distribution before features until the funnel converts; apps.gankdat.com is indexed and now has a sitemap (highlight-keep weava-alternative-page shipped the pattern and the table CSS). Page: side-by-side table (local, no account, free tier, $12 once vs $30/yr and $59 lifetime), one honest paragraph per rival written from the September 2026 review sample, a 'not yet' row for PDF and Google Docs, Chrome + Firefox install buttons, the refund line. The trademarked name of the bolding technique never appears (RESEARCH legal assessment) — the rival is named as 'the official bolding extension'. DONE 2026-10-01 (burn-down): page live in packages/landing/site, 12-row table + four prose sections, linked from index, readfocus.html, LISTING.md and amo-metadata.json; sitemap updated. The AMO description rides the next version sign (amo-listing.ts does not set descriptions); the Chrome text rides the action-013 dashboard visit.
items.proof: Search Console: ≥ 50 impressions or ≥ 5 clicks on the page in 30 days; any install attributed to it

items.title: Day-30 funnel review once both listings are fixed: installs, key activations, sales — keep, fix or kill per STRATEGY §7
items.why: Metrics rows 2026-09-30: 0 Chrome users, 0 Firefox daily users after 8 days public, no ratings — with an AMO listing that had no screenshots and category 'other' (the Chrome listing has its title, category and screenshots). The distribution fixes (AMO previews via the 0.1.1 handoff, the comparison page, the dashboard keywords) all land in the next two weeks; the honest EV in RESEARCH.md is 5–20k users in year one at 1–2 % conversion. This item is the measure step: on the date, read the store-metrics rows, the licence Worker's activation count and the ledger; write the reading into RESEARCH.md; if installs are still zero with every listing fixed, apply §7 (zero sales and zero organic signal → kill date 2026-12-21) or queue the one fix the numbers point at.
items.proof: A RESEARCH.md metrics row on the date with installs, activations and sales, and a decision line in STRATEGY §8

items.title: PDF support: open PDFs in a bundled PDF.js viewer so bolding, ruler and fonts work on them (unlock feature)
items.why: RESEARCH.md: 'every top review [of Reader Line, 20k users] asks for PDF support', Bionic-style tools 'want PDF', Reader Mode Pro and the official tool have none — the single most-requested gap in the niche and named in the product decision as the later release. A feature, so it sits behind the three distribution items above (STRATEGY §5); build only once the day-30 review shows installs. Build: bundle pdf.js (Apache-2.0) as an extension page, intercept PDF navigations on sites the user switched on (optional permission already per-site), apply the same content script to the text layer; e2e test with a fixture PDF. Unlock-tier so it gives the free user a reason to pay. — BUILT 2026-10-01 (burn-down) as 0.2.0: a reader page (reflowed real text, not a canvas viewer — bold/fonts must be visible); free = first page, unlock = whole file; ships with the open handoff.
items.proof: Listing review or support mail mentioning PDF; unlock conversion after the release above the pre-release rate

items.title: reader-mode-alternative.html gains Dyslexly and Half Bold columns — the two names in today's "dyslexia extension" and "adhd reading extension" results — with facts read from their own sites
items.why: 2026-10-04 searches: Dyslexly (dyslexly.com; free, no account, five fonts, line focus, ruler, PDF viewer, Pro ≈ £2/month) and Half Bold (halfbold.vercel.app; free, 8,000+ users, 4.8 from 55 ratings) rank for the queries our page targets and are absent from it. Both are free and local, so write the honest cells: where ReadFocus wins (PDF reflow as real text, paragraph focus, precise bold strength), where it does not. Read their pages and Chrome listings through the relay (add dyslexly.com and halfbold.vercel.app to the allowlist) before writing a cell; never use the trademarked bolding term. Built 2026-10-04 evening: Half Bold from halfbold.vercel.app + its Chrome listing (relay rf-rivals-2026); dyslexly.com returns 403 to the runner, so Dyslexly comes from its Chrome listing only (relay rf-rivals-2026b) and its Pro price is not stated on the page.
items.proof: Search Console impressions for the page at the day-30 review ≥ 50 (unchanged target); rank for "reader mode alternative" recorded
